scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']; for (const file of files) { try { fs.unlinkSync(file); } catch {} } if (!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run typecheck
